shellCommands.command: cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo ---; ls /workspace/__agent_eval__; echo ---; ls /workspace/node_modules | head -50

node server.js > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &
sleep 0.6
curl -s -X POST localhost:3000/api/books -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Project Hail Mary","author":"Andy Weir","notes":"great so far"}'
echo
curl -s -X POST localhost:3000/api/books -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"Dune","author":"Frank Herbert"}'
echo
curl -s localhost:3000/api/books
echo

ID=9d9f21d2-5735-456c-a1bc-5b5920e4780f
curl -s -X PATCH localhost:3000/api/books/$ID -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"status":"finished"}'
echo
curl -s localhost:3000/api/books/$ID
echo
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "book.html direct link status: %{http_code}\n" localhost:3000/book/$ID
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "missing book api status: %{http_code}\n" localhost:3000/api/books/nope
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "index status: %{http_code}\n" localhost:3000/
cat /workspace/data/books.json

curl -s localhost:3000/ | head -30
echo ---
curl -s localhost:3000/app.js | head -5
echo ---
kill %1 2>/dev/null
cat /tmp/server.log
